title: Redwood Sanctuary: Dawn of the Giants
summary: A stunning modern-vintage tribute to Redwood National Park. This piece reimagines the classic WPA travel posters of the 1930s with a dramatic, cinematic color palette of deep forest greens, warm amber, and misty teal, capturing a vintage overland camper nestled beneath towering, ancient sequoias as the first morning light pierces the fog.
